## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change

- [ ] Analytical / metric logic
- [ ] OXY or CSV parsing
- [ ] Alignment
- [ ] Visualization / interaction
- [ ] Responsive layout / accessibility
- [ ] Export / reporting
- [ ] Documentation / deployment

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/smoke_check.py` passes
- [ ] Tested with a non-sensitive OXY/CSV pair
- [ ] No experimental or confidential data is included
- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in `CHANGELOG.md`

For analytical changes, provide expected numerical behavior and regression cases below.

## Analytical/regression notes

Describe before/after values, synthetic cases, edge cases, or why outputs should remain unchanged.
